visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a grey oversized knit sweater and a black skirt is standing behind a wooden table. She is actively arranging a large, dense bouquet containing red, pink, white, and purple flowers with green foliage. The setting is a brightly lit floral studio with various potted plants and floral supplies on shelves in the background. (2) The camera transitions to a closer shot of the woman. She holds the finished, voluminous bouquet with both hands, looking into the camera and smiling broadly. She makes an 'OK' hand gesture with her right hand while supporting the flowers. (3) The scene changes to a posed shot where the woman is leaning her head on her hand, sitting next to a beige handbag-style flower container filled with white and pink blooms. The background is a plain, warm-toned wall. (4) A full-body shot shows the woman standing in a modern indoor space with wooden floors. She is holding the handbag-shaped floral arrangement and wearing long black socks and sneakers. A grey mesh screen divides the room behind her. (5) A series of close-up shots follow, showcasing different floral arrangements: first, the large mixed bouquet in a clear glass vase; second, the handbag arrangement with a blurred Christmas tree in the distance; and finally, a small pink textured vase with delicate white and pink flowers.
